parsed.rationale: All three type-alias-objects — `PlaybackBlendModeKey` (PlaybackBlendMode.swift:89), `MaterialBlendModeKey` (MaterialBlendMode.swift:89), and `OverlayBlendModeKey` (_Plant_OverlayBlendMode.swift:89) — are exact duplicates at line 89 of their respective files within the same `Wallpaper` package, sharing `shared_field_count: 1` and no differing slots. Because they differ only in the blend-mode domain they tag (Playback, Material, Overlay), a single generic `BlendModeKey<Mode>` type parameterised on the mode type would unify all three without loss of type safety, and all three call sites already live in the same package so no cross-package dependency changes are needed.
